correctness.rationale: Using the exact Cianci–Ottina P_2^2 13-point incidence poset and C=S0*S0, independently enumerated all 13^4 maps, finding 853 monotone maps, comparability components 721 and 132, 36 strict comparable edges and 24 three-chains with GF(2) boundary ranks 12 and 23. Exactly 132 maps send C fundamental cycle nontrivially in H1(P;F2), all in one component. Independent beat-point deletion recomputation removes 708 (184 up,524 down), retaining precisely 13 constant maps. Standard finite-space homotopy/beat-point and pi1(RP2)=Z/2 establish direct realization of both classes.
